name: deck_render
description: Render a state to a PNG, returned as an image: at rest, or `t` ms into its cue, at half the canvas's size unless `size` asks for another (the canvas's own for every pixel). With the display list's digest: one digest, one drawing.

oneOf.description: vello on the GPU, in a build with the `gpu` feature (PLAN 0.7).

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

t.description: Ms into the state's cue (its transition, then its motions); at rest without it.

format.description: One of the deck's `formats` (`9:16`), laid out again with its template set.

size.description:
`WxH` pixels, with the canvas's aspect ratio. Without it, half the canvas's size
(960×540 for 1920×1080): enough to see what a state draws, at a quarter of the image's
tokens. Give the canvas's own size for every pixel.

out.description: Also write the PNG here: under the server's working directory or the bundle's folder.
